headline: Nigerian Anti-Drug Agency Seizes $227 Million in Methamphetamine and Arrests Five Mexicans
summary: Nigeria's anti-drug agency seized methamphetamine valued at an estimated $227 million and arrested five Mexican nationals at an industrial-scale drug laboratory in Enugu.
why: Major international cartel busts highlight the growing exposure of African nations to transnational illicit manufacturing and trafficking syndicates.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: Law enforcement actions impact national security and transnational crime networks.
